summary: The PR addresses the issue of pickling a figure with a draggable legend by modifying the `DraggableLegend` class in `legend.py`. However, it lacks tests and documentation.

issues.description: The PR does not include any new tests to verify the fix for pickling a figure with a draggable legend.
The PR does not include any documentation or comments explaining the changes made to the `DraggableLegend` class.
